summary: Austin, TX, graduate of University of Texas Computer Science (UTCS), worked in computer science department from 1992 to 2004, expertise in algorithmic optimizations, interest in programming languages (Haskell, Rust, C++, Scheme), strong opinions on education and software development methodologies, experience as a sysadmin, interest in historical and social issues related to technology, critical of MOOCs and online education, engaged in discussions about economic inequality and social justice, identifies as a technical person rather than a policy-oriented individual.
